purpose: Validate a preflight-ready AgentResponseIntent and project the exact authority/operation handoff required for execution without executing or authorizing that handoff.

gate_semantics.dispatchable_true: intent still matches recorded evidence and its selected candidate, so a caller may explicitly invoke the projected authority boundary
gate_semantics.dispatchable_false: intent is stale, tampered, unavailable, or otherwise not preflight-ready

ignore.effect: evidence remains recorded; no Resolution mutation

request_information.existing_diagnostic_boundary: ResolutionReviewSession::request_diagnostic or ResolutionRevisionChain::request_diagnostic when caller chooses to materialize a ResolutionDiagnostic

identity.dispatch_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over response_intent_fingerprint + selected action + authority + operation + route mode
identity.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not a cryptographic authorization token

typed_requirements.rule: only a dispatchable gate route can produce a ready requirement profile

invariants: the gate never invokes a verifier
the gate never opens a revision
the gate never creates a diagnostic or information request
the gate never mutates Resolution state
ResponseIntent remains selection provenance, not execution authority
the projected destination authority remains the existing verifier/review/revision boundary
ignore is represented as an explicit no-op route rather than deleting evidence
a failed ResponseIntent preflight produces a closed gate and no executable route
